about: Spots where two or more POTA parks may share the same ground (official outlines only, 100 yards across; trails and rivers 100 yards long). HIDDEN, not reviewed: passes [saved, fresh, finest] must all be 1 and status 'candidate' before a person looks. Wording when shown: 'We think these parks overlap. Check both boundaries yourself before you count it.'
